overview_description.description: We’re building an AI-native ERP for food-industry wholesalers, starting by the fish industry. We use AI to help them eliminate manual administrative tasks, cut errors and foodwaste. Wholesalers receive orders from retailers (restaurants, supermarkets, etc.) via WhatsApp, email or text message. We fetch those orders with AI, analyze them, and push them directly into the ERP in a structured format, removing the triple manual data entry
